en: Theragāthā 1.86 Ekakanipāta Navamavagga The Elder’s Verses 1.86, Chapter Nine: The Section of Single Verses (Ekakanipāta) I am one who has crossed over the flood; I am one who has reached the further shore. I have attained the state of peace; I am one who has transcended all bonds. I am one who has abandoned all attachments; I am one who has no more longing for existence. I am one who has conquered all defilements; I am one who has attained the destruction of craving. I am one who has realized the Dhamma; I am one who has seen the Truth. I am one who has attained Nibbāna; I am one who has gone beyond birth and death. I am one who has cut off the stream of rebirth; I am one who has no more future becoming. I am one who has attained the goal; I am one who has fulfilled the holy life. I am one who has laid down the burden; I am one whose task is done. I am one who has reached my own goal; I am one who has destroyed the fetters of existence. I am one who has attained the supreme security; I am one who has reached the bliss of peace. I am one who has transcended all suffering; I am one who has attained the end of all pain. I am one who has realized the fruit of Arhatship; I am one who is worthy of offerings. I am one who has attained the state of the Worthy One; I am one who has no more clinging. I am one who has attained the state of the Tathāgata;

I am one who has no more fear. I am one who has attained the state of the Buddha; I am one who has no more doubt. I am one who has attained the state of the Sage; I am one who has no more delusion. I am one who has attained the state of the Victorious One; I am one who has no more conceit. I am one who has attained the state of the Conqueror; I am one who has no more pride. I am one who has attained the state of the Teacher; I am one who has no more ignorance. I am one who has attained the state of the Knower; I am one who has no more doubt. I am one who has attained the state of the Seer; I am one who has no more darkness. I am one who has attained the state of the Light; I am one who has no more blindness. I am one who has attained the state of the Eye; I am one who has no more obstruction. I am one who has attained the state of Wisdom; I am one who has no more delusion. I am one who has attained the state of Knowledge; I am one who has no more ignorance. I am one who has attained the state of Vision; I am one who has no more blindness. I am one who has attained the state of Peace; I am one who has no more turmoil. I am one who has attained the state of Calm; I am one who has no more agitation. I am one who has attained the state of Tranquility; I am one who has no more restlessness. I am one who has attained the state of Liberation; I am one who has no more bondage. I am one who has attained the state of Freedom; I am one who has no more attachment. I am one who has attained the state of Emancipation; I am one who has no more grasping. I am one who has attained the state of Deliverance; I am one who has no more fetters. I am one who has attained the state of the Unshakable; I am one who has no more wavering. I am one who has attained the state of the Firm; I am one who has no more instability. I am one who has attained the state of the Steadfast; I am one who has no more fluctuation. I am one who has attained the state of the Unmoving; I am one who has no more motion. I am one who has attained the state of the Immovable; I am one who has no more shaking. I am one who has attained the state of the Unwavering; I am one who has no more trembling. I am one who has attained the state of the Unfaltering; I am one who has no more faltering. I am one who has attained the state of the Unfailing; I am one who has no more decline. I am one who has attained the state of the Unchanging; I am one who has no more transformation. I am one who has attained the state of the Imperishable; I am one who has no more decay. I am one who has attained the state of the Eternal; I am one who has no more end. I am one who has attained the state of the Infinite; I am one who has no more limit. I am one who has attained the state of the Boundless; I am one who has no more boundary. I am one who has attained the state of the Peerless; I am one who has no more equal. I am one who has attained the state of the Matchless; I am one who has no more rival. I am one who has attained the state of the Incomparable; I am one who has no more peer. I am one who has attained the state of the Unequaled; I am one who has no more counterpart. I am one who has attained the state of the Unrivalled; I am one who has no more opponent. I am one who has attained the state of the Unconquered; I am one who has no more victor. I am one who has attained the state of the Invincible; I am one who has no more conqueror. I am one who has attained the state of the Unassailable; I am one who has no more assailant. I am one who has attained the state of the Unassailable; I am one who has no more attacker. I am one who has attained the state of the Unshakeable; I am one who has no more shaker. I am one who has attained the state of the Unperturbed; I am one who has no more disturber. I am one who has attained the state of the Unagitated; I am one who has no more agitator. I am one who has attained the state of the Undistressed; I am one who has no more distresser. I am one who has attained the state of the Untroubled; I am one who has no more troubler. I am one who has attained the state of the Unafflicted; I am one who has no more afflicter. I am one who has attained the state of the Unblemished; I am one who has no more blemisher. I am one who has attained the state of the Pure; I am one who has no more impurity. I am one who has attained the state of the Stainless; I am one who has no more stain. I am one who has attained the state of the Spotless; I am one who has no more spot. I am one who has attained the state of the Bright; I am one who has no more darkness. I am one who has attained the state of the Radiant; I am one who has no more gloom. I am one who has attained the state of the Luminous; I am one who has no more obscurity. I am one who has attained the state of the Effulgent; I am one who has no more dullness. I am one who has attained the state of the Splendid; I am one who has no more dimness. I am one who has attained the state of the Glorious; I am one who has no more ignominy. I am one who has attained the state of the Majestic; I am one who has no more meanness. I am one who has attained the state of the Noble; I am one who has no more baseness. I am one who has attained the state of the Sublime; I am one who has no more vulgarity. I am one who has attained the state of the Exalted; I am one who has no more lowness. I am one who has attained the state of the Transcendent; I am one who has no more worldliness. I am one who has attained the state of the Supreme; I am one who has no more inferiority. I am one who has attained the state of the Ultimate; I am one who has no more relativity. I am one who has attained the state of the Absolute; I am one who has no more conditionality. I am one who has attained the state of the Unconditioned; I am one who has no more causality. I am one who has attained the state of the Uncaused; I am one who has no more effect. I am one who has attained the state of the Uncreated; I am one who has no more creation. I am one who has attained the state of the Unborn; I am one who has no more birth. I am one who has attained the state of the Unarisen; I am one who has no more arising. I am one who has attained the state of the Unproduced
The Verse of the Elder Nāgita:
“Outside of this [teaching], for the various proponents of other doctrines,
there is no path leading to Nibbāna such as this one.”
"Thus does the Blessed One instruct the Saṅgha, the Teacher himself showing it as if on the palm of his hand. ...
